# LaTeX packages required by _extensions/cnam-thesis/template.tex
# that are NOT included in Quarto's default TinyTeX installation.
# Installed by the CI workflow; one package name per non-comment line.

# PDF/A compliance
pdfx
colorprofiles

# Fonts — Palatino text (newpxtext) + math (newpxmath)
newpx

# Language
babel-french

# Layout and typography
titlesec
changepage
setspace
indentfirst
tocloft
minitoc

# Tables
booktabs
multirow
diagbox
caption

# Figures and floats
rotating
pdfpages
eso-pic

# Boxes and frames
mdframed
tcolorbox
pgf

# Text formatting
soul
ulem

# Annotations / comments
todonotes

# Code listings
fvextra

# Algorithms
algorithms

# Page references
lastpage

# Glossary and acronyms
glossaries

# Bibliography
natbib

# Miscellaneous
units
zref
needspace
